constraints: PRE-REGISTRATION IS STILL THE POINT: write design.md FIRST, deriving the planted joint law's exact log2_A_k(k) for every k you will report, BEFORE running planted_arm_v2.py on real data. The V1 arm's marginal-law trick still applies and is REUSABLE: choose per-trial which n_e block POSITIONS are 'planted-fail' via the same exchangeable mechanism (e.g. M_t ~ Uniform{17,18,19}, a uniform random M_t-subset of blocks marked fail, S_t = M_t by construction) -- this keeps log2_A_k(k) exactly as closed-form as the V1 arm's, because the marginal law of S_t depends only on which POSITIONS are marked fail, not on what BIT CONTENT realizes 'fail' vs 'succeed' at each position.

THE NEW REQUIREMENT IS ON THE BIT-LEVEL REALIZATION, NOT THE MARGINAL LAW: for a block marked 'planted-succeed', its actual n_2=128-bit content must be a genuine (possibly duplicated) input that the REAL decode_blocks decodes to F_j=0 -- but chosen NEAR its decision boundary (small |WHT top-two margin|), not the zero codeword or any other huge-margin choice. For a block marked 'planted-fail', its content must be a genuine input decode_blocks decodes to F_j=1, similarly near-boundary. 'Near-boundary' means: a single-coordinate perturbation of the kind V1 (circular shift) or V3 (last-block window shift) would inject should plausibly be ABLE to flip the decoded F_j for at least some of your near-boundary templates -- verify this is genuinely possible (not merely near in some unrelated metric) by testing a small number of candidate perturbations against your own candidate templates during design, and report the margin distribution in design.md.

VERIFY EACH TEMPLATE'S TRUE DECODE OUTCOME ONCE, BEFORE GENERATING TRIALS, by running the REAL decode_blocks (sha256-pinned import from stage_a.py, do not modify it) on each candidate template and confirming it returns the intended F_j. This one-time verification is the derivation step design.md must document BEFORE any trial generation -- it is what keeps 'closed-form, derivable in advance' true even though bit-level content is now heterogeneous. A template whose true decode disagrees with its intended label must be discarded or fixed, not silently used.

REUSE THE ESTIMATOR PIPELINE EXACTLY AS THE V1 ARM DID: measure.py's comb_matrix and log2_A_from_hists via direct sha256-pinned import, and the point/loo/jmean/jse jackknife formulas reproduced identically. Do not modify the reused logic.

FAIL-CLOSED, NOT FAIL-OPEN: any self-integrity/hash check must actually read the field it claims to guard and abort on a real mismatch -- demonstrate this with a deliberate-mismatch dry run, as the V1 arm's executor did, and report the result.

DO NOT REPEAT THE V1 ARM'S DOCUMENTATION-PRECISION DEFECT: do not describe this arm's use of decode_blocks in language that could be misread as testing more than it does.
